name: What is Fatmagul's Fault?
description: Fatmagul, a simple happy village girl, is violated by 4 drunk rich young men, the extreme hardship she faces forced to marry a rapist and the great remorse felt by others for their inaction when innocence was violated forms the story.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Fatmagül lives with her brother Rahmi and sister-in-law Mukaddes in a coastal town where beautiful bays are intertwined. Fatmagül is crushed under the pressure of her aunt and her biggest hope for life is her childhood love, her fiancé Mustafa. They will get married as soon as their house, which Mustafa built with his own hands, is finished.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: "Finding a distraught Fatmagül raped, Granny Ebe rushes her to the hospital. Fatmagül is traumatized by the disaster she has experienced. Selim, Erdoğan and Vural slowly realize the atrocity they have caused. Kerim, on the other hand, writhes in pain with growing regret. Mukaddes, who has no news from Fatmagül, sends Rahmi to the town to find her."

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: "Fatmagül, whose life is overshadowed by the dark shadow of four people, gets hope with Mustafa's arrival. Granny Ebe learns that one of the people who did evil to the injured young girl she helped without knowing her is Kerim. Disappointed and angry, Granny Ebe is determined to hand Kerim over to the gendarmes. Mustafa takes action to punish the person who raped Fatmagül with his own hands."

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Thinking that he has no reason to live, he wants to end Fatmagül's life. The anger and helplessness of Fatmagül, whose life he has ruined, makes Kerim face the magnitude of his sin again. Having set his future on fire, Mustafa's anger grows and he continues to swear revenge. Münir and Mukaddes turn the situation in their favor to put their plans into practice.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Fatmagül succumbs to the dark shadows surrounding her and marries Kerim. After the wedding, the last deals of Fatmagül's shattered life will be made. Kerim marries Fatmagül, in whose eyes he has always seen hatred and pain, and the Yasarans take a deep breath. Münir's last move to secure the Yaşarans' name completely is to send Fatmagül and Kerim out of town for good.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: "While Kerim has a big confrontation with Fatmagül, who attacks him as if to avenge all his pain, Mustafa learns the truth he does not want to hear from Münir. On the other hand, Reşat Yaşaran is cornered by the news in the local newspaper. The incident he tries to prevent grows bigger and bigger. Fatmagül's only hope is to be reunited with her brother as soon as possible."

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When Kerim learns that Nana Ebe is also coming to Istanbul, he sets out to find a house for Fatmagül and her family. However, Mukaddes realizes that Kerim will run away after fulfilling this obligatory duty and is determined not to let him go. Mustafa, who embarks on a revenge journey to Istanbul, makes an unlikely traveling companion. Asu, traveling on the same bus, notices Mustafa's sadness.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: On the one hand, Mustafa's steps determined to take revenge and Fatmagül's hatred on the other, motivate Kerim to go abroad as soon as possible. Reşat Yaşaran, who is shocked that his forbidden relationship is discovered by Erdoğan, is cornered. Erdogan, whose anger is sharpening by the minute, plays all his cards openly, while Resat Yasaran faces an unexpected threat.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Realizing that she cannot find the answers to her questions in someone else, Meltem risks everything and confronts Fatmagül. While this confrontation hurts Fatmagül's wound even more, Kerim takes action to convince Meltem. Münir, who learns about Meltem's last move thanks to Mukaddes, intervenes and manages to turn the situation in favor of the Yasarans.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Thinking that Kerim is confronting Mustafa, Ebe Nana tries to prevent what will happen in fear, while Fatmagül's concern is for Mustafa. For the Yasarans, the dinner that starts with Turaner Bey's surprise visit turns into a difficult night with Selim's absence. Kerim, Selim, Erdoğan and Vural, whose statements are taken at the police station, try to prove their innocence.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Kerim meets Mustafa at the police station where he goes to get his passport. With everything on the line, Mustafa doesn't recognize this man who has turned his life upside down. But this will not be their last encounter. The midwife grandmother's efforts to get closer to Fatmagül begin to pay off day by day. Fatmagül realizes Meryem's good intentions and begins to enjoy this woman's friendship.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Mustafa, who learns Kerim's connection with Münir, is forced to choose between his revenge and the new life he has started to build. When Fatmagül learns that Mustafa is going abroad, a new sadness blossoms in her heart. Mustafa, who is constantly honing his anger within himself, is becoming more and more dangerous for Kerim.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Fatmagül learns that Kerim has received a visa to go abroad and starts to wait patiently for the day when her worst enemy will leave her life. Mukaddes, who is unaware of the new developments, continues to order Fatmagül and Kerim to play the “happy family”. The sudden death of Rıfat Yaşaran shocks the whole family.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: "Fatmagül is shocked when she witnesses Kerim's confession. While this confession raises Ebe Nana's hopes for the future, it adds new question marks to Fatmagül's thoughts about Kerim for the first time. The Yaşarans, who learn that Kerim has given up on going abroad, are uneasy about this latest development. Erdoğan, on the other hand, signals how dangerous he will be for Resat Yaşaran."

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: When Kerim learns that Fatmagül hid the farewell letter, there is a small ray of hope for Kerim. Mukaddes again uses this new situation as a trump card in her favor. Ebe Nana is uneasy when she learns that an unknown woman is after Fatmagül. Fatmagül wants to hide this from the people at home, but Ebe Nine, who does not want to leave caution to the wind, shares the situation with Kerim.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Panicked by Fatmagül leaving the house, Kerim goes to the police. But it is very difficult to ask for help by hiding the truth from the police. At the same time, thanks to Mukaddes, the news that Fatmagül has left the house reaches the Yasaran house. When Meltem also learns about the incident, things get even more complicated.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: "Fatmagül faces great dangers in Asu's house. The first danger on the threshold is Mustafa. On the other hand, Kerim, who is searching for Fatmagül day and night, learns Enise's real identity. Now he is even more worried about Fatmagül. When it becomes clear that the woman after Fatmagül is “Asu, the prostitute”, the situation changes even more."

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: "The condition of Fatmagül, whom Kerim brings home half unconscious in his arms, causes joy and panic at the same time. Despite everything, Fatmagül's return also dissipates the dark clouds in Kerim's heart. With his patience and love, Kerim begins to shake Fatmagül's walls that he thought would never collapse."

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: "The truth Fatmagül tells creates a bombshell in the wedding hall. Meltem is now faced with the most difficult decision of her life. Kerim realizes how much their lives will change with this latest situation. Thinking that the Yasarans will surely take revenge, he tries to convince Fatmagül to leave the house. However, Fatmagül is no longer afraid to face her enemies."

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: "Mustafa learns from the person he hates the most, Kerim, that the truth he wants to believe is a big lie. Now both the criminals and the truth are in the open. In the face of Mustafa, Kerim sacrifices even his own life to protect Fatmagül. Fearing for Kerim's life, Grandma Ebe goes to the police despite all the obstacles."

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Mustafa and Fatmagül face each other for the first time after what happened. Months ago, they said silent goodbyes in front of a burning house. Now, they talk in front of the house where Fatmagül is married to someone else. Mustafa will find a completely different Fatmagül. Kerim, who leaves the house with the police, is furious when he learns from Mukaddest that Mustafa came all the way home.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: "When Fatmagül gets rid of the last memory of her past, Kerim gets the biggest ray of hope he has been waiting for months. He is now more courageous to share his feelings with Fatmagül. Grandma Ebe, who wants Fatmagül to live a safe life without fear, puts Reşat Yaşaran on the spot. The Yasarans will stay away from her family and Fatmagül forever."

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Fatmagül starts her new job with great excitement and Kerim is her first visitor. Kerim sees Fatmagül wearing the wedding ring. Now that wedding ring will never come off her finger. Meltem learns that Mustafa is Fatmagül's fiancé and confronts him to talk to him. Mustafa realizes the value of the words between his lips for the Yasarans.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: "Mukaddes reopens the books she was forced to close years ago. Her first love Salih is no longer the old Mukaddes. This encounter will be a turning point in Mukaddes' life. On the other hand, Fatmagül and Kerim are sure that Mukaddes is hiding something from them. Mukaddes has a lie for every situation, but since she can't get over the effect of seeing Salih again, she keeps to herself."

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Fatmagül and Kerim are horrified to learn the secret that Mukaddes has been keeping for years. While Kerim tries to calm Fatmagül with the truth he has heard, neither of them realize that they are sharing a situation for the first time. As Mukaddes tries to explain the situation to Nana Ebe in her own way, Fatmagül and Kerim witness this conversation as well.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: When Mukaddes leaves the house, taking her son Murat with her, Rahmi is devastated. Fatmagül, who is helpless in the face of her brother's situation, receives support from Kerim again. Mukaddes, who knows that she has entered an irreversible path, confronts Salih, this time with Murat. The fact that Salih's father witnesses this encounter is an opportunity that paves the way for Mukaddes.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Fatmagül's anger, shaken by Kerim's confession of love, is stronger than the feelings she cannot even admit to herself. Losing all hope with Fatmagül's reaction, Kerim regrets that he pushed her further away with his confession.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Fatmagül, who is excited to trust someone again after Kerim's confession of love, wants to give Kerim another chance at their future life, despite all the negativity, even though she sees Kerim and Vuralı together. She thinks that Kerim will give a logical explanation for this meeting.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: When Kerim confesses the whole story to the police, risking everything to prove his love to Fatmagül, it is the beginning of a difficult period for Fatmagül. In order for the legal process to begin, Fatmagül must file a complaint. Fatmagül decides to start this difficult struggle even though she knows that she will be worn out during the investigation.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Faced with the police, the Yasarans are unable to stop Selim and Erdoğan from being taken to Izmir to testify. With the official opening of the investigation, Fatmagül and Kerim face threats and denials. As Fatmagül struggles to cope with her fears in this unpredictable struggle, Kerim's fears about how he will be affected by this process increase with each passing minute.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: The decision to remand Selim and Erdoğan in pre-trial detention causes a major shock on the Yaşaranlar front. For the Yasarans, who are aware that even the smallest mistake could have irreversible consequences, Mustafa's testimony, which could change the course of the investigation, becomes more valuable. Mustafa demands the return of Erdoğan's hidden gun as the only condition to decide his side.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: The dangers around Fatmagül and Kerimin, especially Mustafa, bring them closer to each other at every step. This rapprochement, which takes place in front of his eyes, will not be erased from Mustafa's memory. Crushed by the weight of his own actions, Mustafa's anger towards Fatmagül and Kerim grows over time.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: The dinner organized by Kristen is the beginning of a new era for Fatmagül and Kerim. However, this beautiful night will be poisoned again because of Kristin. Meltem, who gives Fatmagül Selim's ring, learns to her surprise that Reşat Yaşaran also knows about it. Reşat Yaşaran pulls out all the stops and Meltem will be his target from now on.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: The letter from Australia shocks everyone, especially Kerim. When Mukaddes, who attracts lightning bolts, claims that Ebe Nana and Fatmagül secretly read the letter in order to defend herself, Kerim's anger is compounded by his disappointment. The fate of the letters, which are torn up without ever being read, changes for the first time with this incident.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: The flower sent to Gül Mutfağı on the opening day is enough to disturb the peace of the whole family. It is not easy to calm Kerim who wants to ask Mustafa to pay for this flower. As the fire of revenge between Kerim and Mustafa flares up again, Münir is the only one who follows this situation with pleasure.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Mustafa's visit to the Rose Kitchen proves Fatmagül's optimistic thoughts wrong. Knowing that Kerim has gone to work and will not return for a long time, Mustafa becomes even more emboldened to disturb Fatmagül. “Gül Mutfağı”, which is the beginning of a brand new era in Fatmagül's life, means for Mustafa his lost past and Fatmagül. This situation increases his anger even more.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Thinking that Fatmagül will meet Mustafa, Kerim starts his secret surveillance. On the other hand, Mukaddes, whose suspicions that she is pregnant are justified, faces a difficult decision as she is about to take a new turn in her life. The morning that starts with doubts for Kerim turns into a happy day when Fatmagül confesses that she has started to trust him.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: The wedding dress Kerim receives as a birthday gift makes Fatmagül's unhealed wounds bleed again. However, this wedding dress, which was bought to make a new start away from the shadows of the past, is like a summary of all the past that Fatmagül wants to forget. While Kerim thinks that he has taken a well-intentioned but wrong step, the biggest ray of hope for Kerim comes from Fatmagül.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: "In the courtroom after months, Fatmagül is for the first time so close to the dark shadows that have fallen on her, and for the first time strong enough to hold them to account. But the sun is still hidden behind the shadows. Erdoğan, Selim and Vural are released at the end of the first hearing. Fatmagül feels defeated once again. She gives up because she is afraid of what will happen next. "

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The day that darkens when Kerim is detained as the only suspect in a crime he did not commit starts a new era that completely changes Kerim and Fatmagül's lives. As Kerim waits in desperation in prison for the day he will stand trial, the first person he wants to convince of his innocence is Fatmagül.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Fatmagül's visit is a breath of fresh air for Kerim. Fatmagül has also started to feel Kerim's absence in her life during the days they have been separated. Although the short time spent in the visitation room is not enough to ease Kerim and Fatmagül's longing, it is a great morale booster for both of them. Time is short and the words to be said are many.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Years later, in prison, Kerim confronts his father, who abandoned him as a young boy. This encounter reveals that the long years that have passed have done nothing to diminish Kerim's anger and hatred. Kerim has closed all doors against his father forever with the last image he remembers of his mother.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Kerim announces the date of the hearing, the atmosphere in the Rose Kitchen suddenly changes. While Fatmagül begins an exciting countdown, Grandma Ebe's joy is overshadowed by the letter left to Kerim by his mother. Grandma Ebe will make her decision about this letter, which she has been hiding for years, after meeting with Fahrettin.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: When the moment of reunion they have been dreaming of for months arrives, Kerim and Fatmagül's hands meet in longing. Kerim's freedom officially opens an era of love and hope in his relationship with Fatmagül. On the journey back to Istanbul, Kerim notices Grandma Ebe's stagnation and sadness.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With the letter left by his mother, Kerim realizes that he has been believing a lie for years and starts to reconsider his whole life. Even his marriage to Fatmagül is now full of question marks for Kerim. Thinking that Kerim will never forgive her, Ebe Nana comes to the brink of a very important decision in this process.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The process that started with the resemblance between Kerim's mother and Fatmagül has dealt a heavy blow to his relationship with Fatmagül. Kerim realizes that it is too late even to regret it. The fear he sees in Fatmagül's eyes is his biggest punishment. Fatmagül, on the other hand, tries to understand Kerim.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Despite Kerim's decision to leave, Fatmagül gives him her last word. Kerim is no longer one of her four enemies, but the man she trusts and wants to continue their marriage. From this point on, Kerim will either take this hand extended to him or lose Fatmagül completely. As Fatmagül's trial approaches, all the developments are against the Yasarans.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Fatmagül and Kerim are left alone in the rainy conditions far from Istanbul. Mustafa, who falls into Münir's trap the same night, realizes that there is no way out of this mud. He has no choice but to submit to the Yasarans once again. Asu also has to obey his decision. Otherwise, both her baby and herself will face danger.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Kerim is swept off his feet when Fatmagül confesses that she loves him. From this moment on, it becomes more difficult for Kerim and Fatmagül to hide the sweet excitement in their hearts from those around them. While there are good and hopeful developments on the Fatmagüls' front, the Yaşaranlar's silence despite the short time left for the trial does not escape Fahrettin Ilgaz's attention.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Trapped and waiting for Kerim to find him, Erdoğan is cornered even more when the police get involved. The fact that Erdoğan has come so close to them revives the old fears of the whole family, especially Fatmagül. On the other hand, while Deniz pursues the real story of Fatmagül and Kerim, Fahrettin is after Asu to find out the truth.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The significant support for Fatmagül from all segments of the society puts great pressure on the Yasarans. After the developments leading up to the day of the trial, the Yasarans are aware that a negative decision may come out of this trial for them. Erdoğan and Münir's last efforts before the court cannot break the hopeful wait on the Fatmagüls' side.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: In order to break the pressure against them, the Yasarans make a press statement targeting Kerim and Fatmagül. When the Yasarans break their silence and get involved in this process with their allegations, journalists become more interested in the case. Some journalists start to hang around Fatmagül every minute, creating exactly the atmosphere the Yasarans want to create.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Fatmagül and Kerim start staying at Fahrettin's house until things calm down. Away from all the problems, the peace and energy of this house provides an environment that Fatmagül and Kerim long for. After Reşat Yaşaran starts to use the power of the media against Fatmagül, he becomes emboldened and starts to squeeze Mustafa even more. As Mustafa is cornered, he looks for a way out.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Another wall is broken between Fatmagül and Kerimin. Mustafa, who confronts the Yasarans to gain his freedom, is defeated by Erdoğan's counter move. The growing tension between Reşat Yaşaran and Erdoğan grows. Erdoğan thinks that his salvation is Fatmagül's saying that she voluntarily gave up the case.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Fatmagül, who suddenly sees Erdoğan in front of her, tries to run away in fear, but Erdoğan does not intend to give up before he makes his speech. Rahmi, who does not want Fatmagül to return home alone, tries to catch Fatmagül's exit from the doctor's office after she finishes her work, but sees that his brother is in a difficult situation and things get out of control.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: "With Münir's blackmail, Rahmi's freedom now depends on Fatmagül giving up her case. The Yasarans realize that they have cornered Fatmagül for the first time during the trial process. They try every means to use this big trump card to the fullest. After Mukaddes learns about the Yaşarans' blackmail, Fatmagül's decision-making process becomes much more difficult."

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The possibility that Erdoğan may have entered their house and touched Fatmagül's wedding dress infuriates Kerim. The wedding dress disintegrates in Kerim's hands and Fatmagül's biggest dream is taken away. Kadir prevents Kerim from confronting Erdogan and demanding accountability. Feeling helpless against the Yasarans, Kerim's anger slowly begins to return to him.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: "Özge's cry for help mobilizes the Fatmagüls. When Fatmagül, Kerim and Kadir reach Özge, the scene they encounter shakes them all deeply. As Özge takes her first step into a big struggle after a long period of silence, Fatmagül is there to support her every moment. Mustafa contacts his family and learns that the police officers who come to the door have nothing to do with Vural's murder."

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: "Wounded by a bullet from Mustafa's rifle, Kerim struggles between life and death in the forest house. While Mustafa tries to destroy all the evidence of the crime, he leaves Kerim alone with his fate. Every minute that passes increases Kerim's life-threatening danger. Kerim's last phone call to Fatmagül drops like a bomb in the middle of the night."

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Difficult days begin for Mustafa, who is detained in connection with Kerim's shooting. The news of Mustafa's detention increases the tension between Kerim and Fatmagül. Fatmagül pursues the reasons why Mustafa wants to kill Kerim. Upon learning that Kerim has been shot, his father comes to Istanbul to be with his son. He tries to convince everyone with Mustafa's false testimony in custody.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: When Kerim opens his eyes, the fears in the hearts of everyone, especially Fatmagül, are replaced by joy. However, this joy does not last long. First, the news of Mustafa's release reaches the hospital. Immediately after this, Mustafa finds a way to confront Kerim, risking all dangers. The fire of revenge in Mustafa brings Kerim and Fatmagül together.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Hearing that Fatmagül wants to sew her wedding dress with her own hands, Kerimin's hopes for the future increase even more. The small steps they take towards each other bring them closer. Before the wedding of Nana Ebe and Kadir, there is a sweet rush in the house. While everyone rushes to prepare for the wedding, Gül's kitchen struggles to fulfill the special orders for Valentine's Day.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Asu, who thinks that she will give Mustafa the biggest punishment by leaving his fate in Fatmagül's hands, disappears after confessing the truth. Now Mustafa's fate is really in Fatmagül's hands. Although Mustafa believes that Fatmagül will not report him, Fatmagül does not think for a minute to file a criminal complaint to the prosecutor's office.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: It is soon revealed that Mustafa has kidnapped Fatmagül. However, it is not possible to reach them. No one can calm Kerim down. In order to save Fatmagül from Mustafa, Kerim resorts to every means. The wave of panic on the Yaşaranlar front reaches its peak when the police arrive at the company. Fatmagül's kidnapping puts the Yasarans in a tight corner because of their connections with Mustafa.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: "The gun that explodes in the old shoe factory saves Kerim's life and puts an end to Fatmagül's nightmare. Mustafa, who is determined to resist until the last moment, will continue to pose a danger to Fatmagül and Kerim's lives. Selim and Erdoğan realize that the circle around them is getting tighter and tighter, and the fear of re-entering the prison envelops them."

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: The arrest warrant issued against the Yasarans is greeted with joy on Fatmagül's side. Fatmagül, on the other hand, is afraid to even hope after everything that has happened. She silently waits for this process to be finalized. On the Yasarans' side, there is a great shock. Erdoğan and Selim, who learn about the arrest decision against Münir and Reşat on television, realize that they are next.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The news of Mustafa's capture causes great joy at home. After a long time, Fatmagül and Kerim are rewarded for their struggle. It is the end of the road for Mustafa, who is hospitalized with serious injuries. A new danger comes to the doorstep of Asu, whose life has been turned upside down since the day she met Mustafa. Kerim and Kadir come to Asu's aid again.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: "Fatmagül and Kerim breathe a sigh of relief when Mustafa is convicted, but the fact that the other criminals are still on the run does not allow the unrest to end completely. While Selim and Erdoğan's journey into the unknown continues under very difficult conditions, Reşat Yaşaran is also having a hard time in prison."

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Having found the house of their dreams, Kerim and Fatmagül start the renovation of their house to step into their new life. Fatmagül and Kerim, who are excitedly completing the deficiencies of their house, become closer in the process. As Fatmagül steps into a new life with hope, Mukaddes becomes increasingly irritable. Mukaddes creates new unrest in the house.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Fatmagül is very uneasy when Kerim leaves everything and goes to his father in the basement before the wedding. While Fatmagül tries to find out the reason behind Kerim's departure, Mukaddes fears that the game she is playing will lead to worse consequences. With Kerim gone, it is up to Rahmi to complete the preparations for the new house.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Fatmagül comes to Kerim in Bodrum, fearing that the distance between her and Kerim is growing. As soon as Kerim sees her, he gets rid of all his worries and tries not to think about Mustafa. Fatmagül is really taking big steps towards Kerim. Mukaddes, fearing that her own game will be exposed, closely follows the developments in Bodrum.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Days before the wedding, Kerim and Fatmagül accelerate their preparations. They are both very happy as the house where they will live together becomes “home” day by day. As Mukaddes Fatmagül and Kerim get closer to each other, she feels relieved thinking that the issue of the letters is forgotten and she wants to destroy the letters before anyone gets them, but things do not go as she wants.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Mustafa, who has been clinging to Fatmagül's dream during his days in prison, finally faces reality. Looking for Fatmagül with great hope, Mustafa loses all hope for his future when he is sure that Kerim and Fatmagül will marry. The fact that Mustafa manages to infiltrate their lives even while in prison pushes Fatmagül and Kerim to take new measures.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Fatmagül and Kerim's wedding, which they have been eagerly awaiting for months, begins with great enthusiasm. Fahrettin and Kadir are in fearful anticipation because the man hired by Mustafa has not been found. Meanwhile, Sami and Asu try to make it to the wedding to identify the man. The man hired by Mustafa to kill Kerim sneaks into the garden of Kadir's house despite all security measures.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: After their first night together, Fatmagül and Kerim cross another very difficult threshold. Only time will heal that great wound from their past. With the news of Mustafa's death, the joy of the wedding house is completely lost. Everyone, especially Rahmi and Mukaddes, is shocked by this situation. It is up to Kadir and Fahrettin to inform Asu that Mustafa has passed away.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Mustafa is not innocent even in death. He wants to leave a guilty conscience between Fatmagül and Kerim that they will carry for the rest of their lives. But neither Fatmagül nor Kerim feels guilty. Fatmagül shares her feelings about the letter with Kerim and proves that she has started a new life by leaving everything from her past aside.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: "After the eventful first days of their marriage, Kerim and Fatmagül quickly get used to their new home and their new life. The absence of Mukaddes from their lives upsets Fatmagül as she is once again away from the children. In the face of Fatmagül's great struggle, Reşat Yaşaran goes to Gül kitchen to apologize to Fatmagül."

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: "Fatmagül and Kerim's vacation takes a pleasant turn when they learn that Selim has been caught. The big crack in the Yasarans is revealed, Münir is found to be the one who denounced Selim, and Rahmi has to make a decision about his marriage when he learns that Mukaddes is behind their backs."

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Fatmagül's birthday is a good opportunity to relieve some of the tension in the days leading up to the trial. The night is brightened by Kerim's surprise and Fatmagül becomes uncomfortable and makes great efforts not to show her uneasiness. At the end of the night, Fatmagül will be the real surprise. Mukaddes, who feels herself ostracized from the family, takes a new decision.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: This hearing promises to be very difficult for Fatmagül, who comes to the courthouse saying “Let this be the last time” and has to look her enemies in the eye one more time. This time the defendants include Mukaddes, lawyer Münir Telci and Reşat Yaşaran. Will the dark shadows cast over Fatmagül finally be lifted? What will life be like for Fatmagül and Kerim from now on?
